info.title: PiAPI/Wanx Universal API
info.description: Generate WanX videos and retrieve task results

post.summary: Create Image to Video with Camera Control
post.description: Creates a camera-controlled video task in PiAPI/Wanx.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

input.prompt.description: Describe the video you want WanX to generate.
input.prompt.example: A cinematic scene with natural motion and consistent detail

input.negative_prompt.description: Describe elements you want the model to avoid.

input.image.description: Image URL or base64 image data for WanX image-to-video generation.

input.control_camera_settings[].description: Array of camera control objects such as [{"type":"static","config":{"horizontal":0,"vertical":0,"pan":0,"tilt":0,"roll":0,"zoom":0}}].

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.summary: Create Image to Video with Keyframes
post.description: Creates a keyframed image-to-video task in PiAPI/Wanx.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

input.prompt.description: Describe the video you want WanX to generate.
input.prompt.example: A cinematic scene with natural motion and consistent detail

input.negative_prompt.description: Describe elements you want the model to avoid.

input.aspect_ratio.description: Supported ratios are 16:9 and 9:16. PiAPI defaults to 16:9.

input.start_image.description: Image URL or base64 image data for the starting frame.

input.end_image.description: Image URL or base64 image data for the ending frame.
